primary_route: Yeast-juice fractionation, chemical add-back and heat-dependent functional reconstitution.

checks.quote: # Proposed Protocol: Testing Requirement for a Heat-Stable Separable Factor in Yeast-Juice Fermentation
checks.reason: No proposal to consult prior Methods, supplements or validated protocols and verify detailed-condition transfer before execution.
Inactive analog replaces enzyme fraction R rather than candidate F, so does not test restoring-factor specificity; no candidate-depleted matrix with inhibitor-rescue validation.
Heat survival/filtration cannot establish a non-protein chemical class.
No actual separation/cutoff/recovery/recipe procedure; contradictory heat acceptance separately belongs to P13.
Gas standard helpful, but no accuracy/leak/blank gate and failed-calibration action.
No fixed gas amount/time unit convention or blank/weak/saturated/missing rules.
Independent units/nesting given but no precision/power justification.
Conductivity cannot yield the individual-ion recipe required for salt exclusion.

checks.quote: All values below must be measured
checks.reason: No bounded fraction/dose/heat/ion exploration with objective selection and confirmation lock.

checks.quote: Do not add arms post hoc
checks.reason: Exploratory labeling does not provide refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after repair.

checks.quote: Each comparator arm in the max
checks.reason: Primary contrast/C3 require heated F plus intact R to be inactive despite heat-stable-factor rescue prediction; C6 also requires rediluted active F+R inactive. Mandatory success rules contradict the intended hypothesis.
No second separation principle or operational independent product validation.
Seed alone does not supply raw-file/unit/provenance and versioned code/settings audit.
